verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers Greenhouse's API, job boards, reporting, AI notetaker, and onboarding features, but contains no mention of interview kits being attached to calendar invites, scorecards being bundled with invites, or automated reminders to interviewers to submit feedback. Missing for 10: evidence of calendar invite content (interview kit/scorecard), automated interviewer feedback reminders, and any scheduling-related documentation confirming this specific workflow.
